overlooked_assumption: The agent assumed that changing the default from `= []` to `= Field(default=[])` would preserve the same runtime behavior when the model is used with `defer_build=True`, but it overlooked that pydantic's `Field(default=[])` with `defer_build` creates a shared mutable default that is evaluated once at class definition time and reused across all instances under concurrent load, causing the `MockValSer` proxy to be shared and the `use_litellm_proxy` attribute to be missing on first access.
why_it_breaks: With `defer_build=True` (the default), pydantic defers schema building until the first instance is created. The `Field(default=[])` default is bound to the class and shared across all instances. When concurrent requests hit a fresh worker, the first instance triggers schema build and the shared list default is used. Because the list is created before the full model validation runs, the `MockValSer` proxy wraps the list but the inner `WorkerRegistryEntry` objects may not have their `use_litellm_proxy` attribute resolved yet, leading to the `AttributeError`. The original `= []` created a fresh list per instance at definition time (eager), which avoided this sharing issue.
